## What This Is

Three artifacts retired from the closeout ritual after a structural audit. The session log and the git commit are the canonical ledger. The AI Interface Change Log was redundant. The Continuity Log was dormant; auto-memory absorbed its function. The closeout skill is rewritten to make lightweight the default with explicit triggers for full mode. The session log template is now standardized to remove format-decision overhead at write time.

## What It Adds / Changes

**Retired (archived to `Vault (Archive)/Council Chamber/`):**
- AI Interface Change Log (`Council Chamber/AI Interface/AI Interface Change Log.md`) — session log is the permanent record
- Continuity Log (`Council Chamber/AI Interface/Continuity Log.md`) — auto-memory carries process patterns forward across sessions
- AI Interface Change Log Protocol (`Council Chamber/Protocols/AI Interface/AI Interface Change Log Protocol.md`) — no longer in active flow

**Session Closeout SKILL.md rewrite:**
- **Lightweight is the default.** Single inline Reconciliation Summary section in the session log covers three buckets: Pending Plans referenced or touched (max 3 bullets), Quests/Experiments/Intake, Inbox/Consults.
- **Full mode is opt-in**, triggered by: 3+ Pending Plans touched, governance file edits, structural reorganization, plan implementation advance, or explicit Sovereign request. In full mode, three parallel Workers (A/B/C) dispatch simultaneously.
- **Standardized session log template** (Variant A): YAML frontmatter (`date`, `title`, `status`, `skills`, `primary_skill`, `commits`, `dispatches`) + `## What Happened` + `## Decisions` + `## Risks` + `## Next` + `## Reconciliation Summary` + `## Notes`.
- **Sovereign Command sweep is mandatory in both modes.** Before finalizing closeout, scan live-signal sections of `Sovereign Command.md` and remove any entry this session resolved or rendered obsolete.
- **Breadcrumb Propagation Sweep** is conditional. Default in lightweight mode is skip. It runs only when this session created new governance artifacts (new Pending Plans, codices, protocols, or structural file moves affecting 3+ active files).
- **Append session log to the Index.** After writing the session log, append a single row to `Vault (Archive)/Session Logs/Index.md` and update `last_updated` and `entry_count`. The log is not fully logged until the row exists.

**Cross-reference cleanup (high-traffic files):**
- AI Interface Knowledge Map: Continuity Log and Change Log entries removed from Core Systems; Session Logs Index added; Audit Cadence note now points to session log + git commit as the canonical ledger.
- Operating Charter: Review Rule no longer references the Change Log; structural changes are logged via session log entries and git commits.
- AI Interface Activation Protocol: gap-adaptive tier logic now reads Session Logs Index instead of Change Log; Continuity Check section rewritten to point to session logs and auto-memory.
- AI Interface Activation skill: Related Protocols section updated; Step 2 reads Session Logs Index instead of Change Log.
- Session Closeout Protocol: Step 8 (add Change Log entry) replaced with append-to-Session-Logs-Index step; Continuity Notes section replaced with Process Pattern Capture (auto-memory + skill Refinements).
- MODULES.md: removed `runtime-created` entries for the two archived log files.

## How to Implement

If you have an existing ecosystem built on prior versions:

1. **Archive the three retired artifacts.** Move each to a Vault subdirectory rather than deleting (history matters):
   - `Council Chamber/AI Interface/AI Interface Change Log.md` → `Vault (Archive)/Council Chamber/AI Interface/AI Interface Change Log Archive.md`
   - `Council Chamber/AI Interface/Continuity Log.md` → `Vault (Archive)/Council Chamber/AI Interface/Continuity Log Archive.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/AI Interface/AI Interface Change Log Protocol.md` → `Vault (Archive)/Council Chamber/Protocols/AI Interface/AI Interface Change Log Protocol Archive.md`

2. **Replace the Session Closeout skill.** Pull the new `Council Chamber/Skills/Session Closeout/SKILL.md` and run it as the new default closeout pattern.

3. **Wikilink audit.** Grep your ecosystem for references to the retired artifacts and update them to point to the session log Index, auto-memory, or simply remove the obligation. Files most likely to carry a stale reference:
   - `MODULES.md`
   - `CHANGELOG.md` (historical entries only; leave alone)
   - `Council Chamber/AI Interface/AI Interface Knowledge Map.md`
   - `Council Chamber/AI Interface/Operating Charter.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Codices/Challenge and Illumination Codex.md` (Governed By line)
   - `Council Chamber/Codices/Contrast Layer Codex.md` (Governed By line + Phase Audit Protocol section)
   - `Council Chamber/Checklists/Pending Plan Reconciliation Checklist.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Governance/Flywheel Integration Standard.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Governance/Governance Constellation.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/AI Interface/AI Interface Activation Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Archival/Collaboration Archival Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Expression/Article Drafting Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Flywheels/Flywheel Codex Stewardship Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Flywheels/Universal Vault Flywheel Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Governance/Meta-Governance Audit.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Governance/Naming and Versioning Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Governance/Platform-Agnostic Interface Adapter Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Planning/Pending Plan Reconciliation Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Protocols/Session/End-of-Week Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Skills/End-of-Week/SKILL.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Skills/Skills Governance Protocol.md`
   - `Council Chamber/Skills/Weekly Story/SKILL.md`

   This update fixes the high-traffic files in the template repository. The peripheral references above are listed so your AI can grep your ecosystem and propose edits in one pass.

4. **Confirm Session Logs Index exists.** If you do not yet have one, create `Vault (Archive)/Session Logs/Index.md` with frontmatter `last_updated:` and `entry_count:` plus a table with columns `Date | Title | Primary Skill`. The Session Closeout skill appends to this on every closeout.

5. **Auto-memory carries forward.** Process patterns and lessons that previously went into the Continuity Log now belong in your AI's auto-memory as `feedback` type entries. This persists across sessions automatically. No manual file maintenance needed.

## Prerequisites

Foundation build complete (Session 1 minimum). Auto-memory architecture configured (covered in `CLAUDE.md` template, ships in v1.9.0+).

## Optional?

No. The Session Closeout skill is foundational. Stale Change Log obligations otherwise generate friction at every closeout.

<!-- Easter Egg: The session log records what happened. The git commit proves it happened. Anything else is a habit looking for a reason to still exist. -->
